verdict.rationale: Evidence shows GitLab consolidates security scanners (SAST, SCA, Secret Detection, DAST) with findings surfaced in MRs/IDEs, which supports some policy enforcement, but there is no direct evidence of compliance frameworks, push rules, approval policies, or CI/CD pipeline enforcement mechanisms across teams/repos in this pack. Community evidence focuses on reliability/outages rather than governance features, leaving the core enforcement capability under-evidenced.
